delay.description: Sampling delay, optionally with suffix (m/h/d/w/y); e.g., '60', '5m'

count.description: Number of sampling intervals to run before exiting (if omitted, runs indefinitely)

cumulative.description: Use cumulative totals over all time instead of per-interval averages

strip_path.description: Strip directory path from filenames (use basename only)

force_output.description: Force output even when no file activity occurred during interval

by_device.description: Order statistics by unique device (major, minor) instead of filename

include_paths.description: Comma-separated list of paths to monitor (all filesystems by default)

by_inode.description: Order statistics by unique device (major, minor) and inode

merge_events.description: Merge consecutive events on same file from same process

no_periodic.description: Suppress periodic statistics; show only verbose (event-level) output

processes.description: Comma-separated list of process IDs or names to monitor

sort_by_pid.description: Sort stats by PID first, then totals, then filename

sort_by_reads.description: Sort stats by number of reads first

disable_scaling.description: Disable K/M/B scaling of numeric output

top_n.description: Only display top N busiest files

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (show per-event access info)

sort_by_writes.description: Sort stats by number of writes first

exclude_paths.description: Comma-separated list of paths to exclude from monitoring
